name: LangChain: Pre-merge CI (DevOps)
description: DevOps gate — no agent reasoning — documents pre_merge_ci.sh invocation. Optional companion to review automation.

prompts:
Run the LangChain **pre-merge CI gate** for the current branch.

**Model:** Sonnet is acceptable; this task is mostly shell execution.

**Steps:**
1. Identify changed package(s) from `git diff --name-only master...HEAD`.
2. Run `.cursor/scripts/pre_merge_ci.sh --base master <package-path> "<proposed-pr-title>"` from repo root.
3. If dependency files changed and this is NOT a release PR, report failure and explain `--allow-deps` is for maintainers only.
4. Summarize pass/fail and which CI workflows will run (see `.cursor/rules/ci-compliance.mdc`).

Do not modify source files unless gates fail and fixes are required.
